messages:
maya: Quick check — can owners confirm the final reservation counts for EU-dedicated nodes and the fallback plan if the H100 shipment slips? Need to lock by EOD.

jay: @maya EU reservation currently 28 nodes (r7) reserved. ETA from procurement is 2026-03-22. If shipment delays, fallback is to shift 8 nodes from staging (us-west) to eu via cross-region transfer + reserved burst. Need approval from serena for routing.

serena: I can approve the routing, but need confirmation on thermal margins. Rack team flagged some cabinets in eu-3 as high-heat. @lee can you confirm power headroom?

lee: eu-3 racks show ~8-10% headroom at baseline. With H100 we need ~15% headroom per rack. We have a plan to redistribute to eu-1 (3 racks) but that'll take ~6h per rack for re-cabling. Not ideal during canary.

amanda: ops-bot posted a smoke build tomorrow 09:00 UTC. If we do re-cabling, we should move the smoke to 15:00 UTC. @ops-bot any objections?

ops-bot: incident-bot: scheduled smoke-run: 2026-03-19T09:00Z. To reschedule run, post `/reschedule-smoke <run-id> <ISO-time>`.

maya: OK. Proposed plan: (1) hold current EU reservations (28) as committed; (2) shift 4 staging nodes to EU as short-term buffer; (3) reschedule smoke to 15:00 UTC; (4) trigger thermal canary on control rack. Anyone opposed? :thinking:

jay: +1 on plan. I'll open the reservation change PR and tag infra-scheduling. :white_check_mark:

serena: +1. For the thermal canary, use the lower sampling window (30s) and alert at 75C.

lee: FYI snippet for the canary cron: 
```yaml
canary:
  sample_period: 30s
  alert_temp_c: 75
  nodes: ["eu-1-rack2-node5","eu-3-rack1-node2"]
```
will deploy in staging in 10m.

amanda: I'll reschedule smoke now. `/reschedule-smoke 78f2a 2026-03-19T15:00Z` :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reservation-change PR #452 created by @jay; CI passed.

maya: Thanks. Last ask — owners for capacity routing policy update to allow auto-fallback to quantized gpus if thermal triggers? Who will own that config?

jay: I can own the routing policy change. Will pair with serena for model quality guardrails.

serena: allocate me to review. If thermo canary trips, staging->eu shift must be manual-only until we confirm weights.

maya: Great. I'll summarize and post to the weekly status doc. Thanks team :pray:
